official_scoring_sequence.type: 28-yard Nate Sheppard passing TD to Brody Keefe with 1:14 left; PAT missed

postgame_causal_findings.evidence: Frozen Duke +0.672 expected vs actual Duke +3, but projected total 47.941 vs actual 35
postgame_causal_findings.implication: Relative team assessment was reasonable, scoring distribution and dependence overstated. Evaluate persistent low-total residuals across independent games before changing global scoring priors.

postgame_causal_findings.evidence: Virginia 53 carries for 195; Duke 19 for 71; both 3.7 YPC; Virginia 38:47 possession vs Duke 21:13
postgame_causal_findings.implication: Test offensive balance, possession lengths, third-down stalls and relative rush-attempt distribution, not just rushing efficiency or yard totals; opponent-matched early rushing success in archived refresh nearly identical Duke .394244 vs UVA .394538.

postgame_causal_findings.evidence: Virginia 4-for-4 red-zone scores, 1 TD/3 FG, 4 pts per trip; Duke 1 redzone FG and two touchdowns from beyond redzone
postgame_causal_findings.implication: Measure joint probability of red-zone entry and TD-vs-FG, distinguish scoring rate from touchdown rate. No fitting on target result.

postgame_causal_findings.evidence: Virginia allowed five sacks and 26 lost yards; Duke one sack, 4 yards; Virginia converted just 5 of 17 third downs
postgame_causal_findings.implication: Candidate pressure/protection and 3rd-long disruption features should be measured from eligible prior play data, independent of opponent quality.

postgame_causal_findings.evidence: Duke QB Walker Eget left after first drive, backup Dan Mahan played rest of first half; Eget returned second half; UVA led 13-7 at half
postgame_causal_findings.implication: Evaluate distribution-level in-game QB disruption in historical series; no retroactive claim that Eget's injury could be known pregame; do not reactivate rolled-back CFB personnel implementation.

postgame_causal_findings.evidence: Nate Sheppard RB completed 28-yard TD pass to Brody Keefe with 1:14 left, finishing 75-yard drive; missed PAT; UVA ended on fourth-down INT
postgame_causal_findings.implication: Allow empirical rare skill-position passing tail in game-script research; do not infer common occurrence or tune event rate from single game.

postgame_causal_findings.evidence: Both teams threw one interception; Virginia lost one fumble, Duke did not; no defensive or special-teams touchdowns
postgame_causal_findings.implication: Turnovers and drive-ending 4th-down interception must not double count as defensive points or phantom ensuing possession; status of live final defensive possession.

candidate_research_and_validation.method: Replay independent pregame-frozen 2025/2026 holdouts, paired 5000 draws with same seeds; compare margin MAE, total MAE, observed totals low-tail coverage and market ATS calibration; include QB-missed-time diagnostics and no target leakage.

candidate_research_and_validation.mechanism: RZ scoring opportunity TD-vs-FG and FG miss co-occurrence
candidate_research_and_validation.method: Separate entry frequency, opponent-adjusted TD conditional on entry, distance-conditioned FG outcomes, and failed third-down/goal-to-go chains; test on historical held-out games and avoid duplicating red-zone regression already active.

candidate_research_and_validation.mechanism: Rush-attempt volume shares and pass pressure/sack conditionality
candidate_research_and_validation.method: Use prior-game offense pass/rush play types and pressure/sacks identified from source PBP; compare response to actual rush opportunities and third down against frozen history; run paired 5000 on truly out-of-sample games.

candidate_research_and_validation.mechanism: Rare skill pass and temporary QB substitution tails
candidate_research_and_validation.method: Quantify occurrence from multi-season observed eligible historical PBP; no game-day injured starter input or personnel code reinstatement; measure tails rather than point-estimate game winner.
